newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 323 mln stg help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 323 mln stg help.

text.p: The Bank of England gave the market 323 million stg of assistance in outright purchases and repo to help offset an estimated money market shortage of 2.05 billion stg.
The repo rate is unchanged at 6.5 percent.
The central bank bought 28 million stg of bills outright and 295 million in repos to July 9 and 10.
In an early round of operations the Bank purchased 35 million stg of bills outright and 430 million in repos.
